title: No Part Library message when the typed description only differs in case
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SAMEDESC-01) is stocked at {Location-B} only, with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Same Desc).
  • {Location-A} stocks no part numbered {Part-A}.
  • {Description-B} (for example zzautotest pl same desc) is {Description-A} typed all in lower case.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. In Description, type two spaces, then {Description-B}, then two spaces.
  3. Type {Part-A} in Part Number, exactly as written down.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the part is saved and the window closes. No message about the Part Library appears (no "Part created. Linked to … was kept." message).
  • Step 7: one row for {Part-A}, with the Description still {Description-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R9, S7-R10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Saved and linked to the Part Library entry), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R9: “When the part was linked to an existing entry whose description differs from the one typed, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces before and after, the system shows "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." For example: "Part created. Linked to N68SL-356 in the Part Library. Its description "BRAKE PAD" was kept."”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
